title: Actual PR VAD gate and main branch protection
owner: Richard Lee; review pending for this change
purpose: Require a current VAD record plus passing Python tests for main PRs and demonstrate both blocked and allowed paths on an actual PR.
environment: Local macOS Python 3.13.2; GitHub Ubuntu 24.04 Python 3.9 and 3.13; GitHub Actions contents:read; administrator API used only for requested branch protection.
recovery: Restore the saved previous main protection settings if needed; revert the PR workflow and selector helper together. No VAD record schema or user data migration.

impact.paths: PR workflow -> selected_change_id -> existing paths ID validation -> existing check/report. Main protection requires the three actual check-run names.
impact.data: Add one CI selection pointer and a new change record. Preserve all historical records and approvals; do not reuse past approval for this new source.
impact.permissions: Read-only Actions, no persisted checkout credentials, no pull_request_target. Requested repository administration enables main branch protection. Existing PR #3 must also satisfy new policy.
impact.regression: Manual input and reusable workflow remain supported; strict PR check gets a unique name so manual success cannot satisfy it. Default PR merge tree is verified; missing or invalid pointer blocks.

criteria.AC-1: PRs targeting main automatically run a strict VAD PR gate for a validated .vad/ci-change-id selection.
criteria.AC-2: Missing, malformed and symlinked selection files fail; dynamic IDs cannot inject workflow outputs.
criteria.AC-3: Actual PR without current human approval is blocked while diagnostics remain available.
criteria.AC-4: Main requires the observed VAD PR gate and both Python test contexts, up-to-date base, PR changes, no admin bypass, no force-push/deletion.
criteria.AC-5: Existing CLI, manual gate, source freshness and read-only checks remain intact; human approval remains explicit.

regression.procedure: Run CLI integration suite and selector cases locally; verify both Python matrix jobs on actual PR.
regression.expected: All tests pass; invalid selector cases reject; manual explicit IDs still validate.

docs.procedure: Check YAML, Python 3.9 syntax, local Markdown targets, documented JSON and whitespace. Review planned protection settings and saved previous policy.
docs.expected: Documentation and configuration match the implemented policy; no unsupported claim of native reviewer authentication.

pr-blocking.procedure: Open actual PR, observe failed VAD PR gate from missing verification/approval and successful diagnostics export.
pr-blocking.expected: Actual PR cannot satisfy readiness before review; no fabricated approval.

protection.procedure: Apply requested main protection using actual GitHub Actions check names; GET policy and inspect actual PR merge state while VAD fails.
protection.expected: Required contexts and admin enforcement match intended policy; PR is blocked without bypass.

agent_execution.initiating_human: User requested actual PR validation and branch protection/required checks
agent_execution.tools: Python, Git, GitHub CLI, GitHub REST API
agent_execution.approval: New change awaits explicit human review; prior Richard Lee approval is not reused.
